source_of_truth: bibles/ hold every character fact. This file holds pointers + extraction rules + structured data, including the assigned outfit layer. Identity blocks carry no outfit sentence; never duplicate block prose.
delimiter_convention: Machine markers look like <!-- PROMPT-BLOCK-START: <id> --> and <!-- PROMPT-BLOCK-END: <id> -->. The compiler extracts marker-to-marker and strips the marker lines themselves. Heading-based rules remain only where no verbatim block exists yet.
layout: Each character lives in bibles/<character>/ with its bible file(s) and reference images side by side. Reference filenames match the names the bibles already use.

shared_blocks.render_grade_animated: Flat painterly cel animation — bold clean ink outlines, flat colour fills with soft cel shading, the look of a hand-drawn animated feature film: a classic cartoon mystery adventure retold as an animated film still. Cinematic composition, dramatic motivated lighting rendered in cel tones. 4:5 portrait composition. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no captions, no logos and no watermark anywhere in the image.
